newsitem.title: FRANCE: L'Oreal to build factory in Poland.
newsitem.headline: L'Oreal to build factory in Poland.

text.p: L'Oreal said on Thursday it had agreed in principle to buy a factory from Henkel Austria Gruppe for an undisclosed amount in Brwinow, Poland.
The company said in a statement it planned to open the factory as soon as possible and said it could produce shampoos, beauty care and hair colour products as early as the beginning as 1997.
The deal will be completed after receiving the agreement of Polish authorities, the company said.
L'Oreal said Brwinow is 20 kilometres from Warsaw.
The company said it was entering the deal in order to meet demand generated by rapid sales growth in eastern Europe, particularly in Poland, Hungary and the Czech Republic.
